blocks.text: Mactan Newtown has been officially declared the Tourism, Culture, and Investment Capital of Lapu-Lapu City, cementing the township’s role as a cornerstone of the city’s growth and heritage. The declaration took effect under Executive Order No. 2026-072, which formally recognizes Mactan Newtown’s contributions to tourism development, cultural preservation, and investment promotion in Lapu-Lapu City. The order highlights the township’s integrated design, which brings together commercial, residential, and leisure spaces that reflect both modern progress and the island’s historical identity.
